title: Invariant Leaves the Loop
prompt: Implement `long long hoisted(int base, size_t n)` totaling base*2 + i for i in 0..n-1, computed with the invariant `base*2` *outside* the loop (store it in a local first). Implement `long long naive(int base, size_t n)` recomputing base*2 inside the loop. Both return the same value — the optimizer may hoist the naive one anyway; the discipline is yours to keep.

tests.name: identical totals
tests.hint: Reordering an invariant out of a loop cannot change the sum — only the instruction count.

tests.name: sum value is right
tests.hint: n=4, base=5: each term is base*2 + i.
